name: The Yards
title: Rail yards on split levels, sheds and footbridges

tiers.14: Station Hill and the Coal Stage

description: The ground steps down from west to east in broad yards: Station Hill and the Coal Stage at +14, the High Yard at +7, the Goods Yard at 0 where the camp sits on the Junction Wedge, the Engine Yard at -7 and the Main Line Cut at -14. Wide flat yards give long views, but every view ends at a drop or a shed, and rakes of parked wagons are the cover. North, a steel ramp lifts you onto the Signal Gantry, a walkway on legs over the yard throat, and on up to City Hall on Station Hill. East, an incline runs down beside the camp and out across the Engine Yard into the Cut, to a sunk tunnel portal. South, a covered footbridge hops over the wagon rakes, then the Goods Shed takes you under its roof to the Bonded Warehouse, a ground door. West, a broad haul ramp climbs to the High Yard's sidings and the Coal Stage incline to a raised hall at +14. The coaling tower and the Roundhouse mark the east.
